articles.title: SJAA EPHEMERIS
articles.summary: The San Jose Astronomical Association (SJAA) held a highly successful annual Auction and Swap Meet on April 4, 2004, raising substantial funds for the club through the sale of various astronomy equipment and prints, highlighted by an engaging auctioneer. The article also outlines the SJAA's upcoming activities for May and June 2004, including general meetings, ATM (Amateur Telescope Making) classes, astronomy classes, star parties, and deep sky weekends.

articles.title: Foothill College Lecture Series
articles.summary: The article announces an upcoming lecture by Dr. Yvonne Pendleton from NASA Ames Research Center on May 19th, focusing on the heat of infant stars, comets, and life's building blocks, held at Houge Park. It also provides a detailed recap of a successful SJAA auction and swap meet event, highlighting generous donations, the sale of numerous astronomy items, and significant funds raised for the association.

articles.title: You Can And Cannot See
articles.summary: This article discusses upcoming celestial events, lamenting that several, like lunar eclipses and a Venus transit, will not be visible locally. The author then addresses the challenge beginners face with overly complex lunar maps, introducing a customizable map template designed to simplify lunar observation. It concludes with a positive review of John Westfall's "Atlas Of The Lunar Terminator" as a useful primer for lunar observers.

articles.title: The shallow sky
articles.summary: This article provides advanced tips for observing Jupiter, detailing features like the Great Red Spot's turbulence, festoons, and the equatorial band, and encouraging sketching. It also discusses observing Venus's changing phases and prominently features the rare Venus transit of the Sun in June 2004, offering details on visibility and preparation. Additionally, it announces and promotes AstroCon 2004, a major astronomy convention in the San Francisco Bay Area in July.

articles.title: Articles and Events
articles.summary: This article outlines an advanced observing program for 'galaxy season,' focusing on identifying HII regions (star-forming areas) within distant galaxies, featuring detailed notes and coordinates for several NGC and IC objects. It also provides a comprehensive astronomical calendar for May 2004, including lunar phases, planetary positions, and dark sky times. Furthermore, it announces a general meeting where author Ken Croswell will discuss his book 'Magnificent Mars.'

articles.title: SJAA loaner scope status
articles.summary: The article provides an update on the San Jose Astronomical Association's (SJAA) loaner telescope program, detailing which scopes are currently available for immediate loan, those that are out on short-term loan, and those with extended loan periods or undergoing repair. SJAA members can contact Mike Koop to borrow a telescope, with options to pick up available scopes at SJAA events or be placed on a waiting list for those currently loaned out.
